name: bastion-workspace
description: A hardened operating environment for self-hosted workerd

scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd core typecheck && bun run --cwd warden typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd core test && bun run --cwd warden test
scripts.test:coverage: bun run --cwd core test:coverage && bun run --cwd warden test:coverage
scripts.build:binary: bun run build:dashboard && bun run --cwd warden build:binary && bun warden/scripts/embed-dashboard.ts --restore
scripts.build:dashboard: bun run --cwd dashboard build && bun run --cwd warden embed:dashboard
scripts.verify: bun run prettier:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:reachability

author: Gregory Mitchell <me@gmitch215.xyz>
